routing_rules: Match primary domain first — highest confidence
If no primary match, check secondary domains
If query mentions a named entity, match entity directly to report
If query spans two domains, return both reports ranked by relevance
If query is ambiguous, ask one clarifying question
Never return more than two reports per query
Always include the key finding and the report link
